Endocrinology Calculators

8 calculators for endocrinology and related laboratory work.

Free Androgen Index (FAI)

Calculates the Free Androgen Index from total testosterone reported in ng/mL and SHBG reported in nmol/L.

HOMA-Beta

Estimate beta-cell function using the original HOMA model.

HOMA-IR

Estimate insulin resistance from fasting glucose and insulin.

LDL / HDL Ratio

Calculate LDL to HDL ratio.

LDL Cholesterol — Friedewald

Estimate LDL cholesterol using the Friedewald equation for conventional mg/dL inputs.

Non-HDL Cholesterol

Calculate non-HDL cholesterol.

QUICKI

Calculate the Quantitative Insulin Sensitivity Check Index.

Total Cholesterol / HDL Ratio

Calculate the total cholesterol to HDL ratio.
